summary: Master IoT Hospitality Implementation. Learn to deploy smart room tech, automate BMS, and secure guest data with expert-led training. Enroll today.
lede: IoT hospitality implementation connects sensors, actuators, and data analytics to help hotels deliver more responsive services and gain real-time visibility across their operations. This course gives you a practical framework for integrating smart solutions with legacy property management systems while addressing guest expectations, energy management, and workforce pressures. You will learn to design sensor networks, deploy edge computing, connect IoT data with CRM platforms, and automate processes such as HVAC predictive maintenance and occupancy forecasting. Through hands-on practice with vendor evaluation matrices, ROI dashboards, low-code automation, and the NIST SP 800-213 cybersecurity standards for IoT devices, you will build the skills to manage scalable deployments while protecting guest data and network integrity.
audienceIntro: This course is essential for professionals responsible for the digital and physical infrastructure of modern hospitality environments.
audience: Hotel Security and Compliance Officers focused
modules: IoT Hospitality Landscape and Strategic Alignment
IoT Strategy Integration and ROI Reporting
prerequisites: Participants should have a basic understanding of hotel operations or hospitality IT infrastructure. Familiarity with general networking concepts (Wi-Fi, IP addressing) is recommended. No prior programming experience is required, but an interest in data-driven decision-making is essential.
